text: Computer Science and Technology is a comprehensive discipline that studies the design, principles, applications and related technologies of computers. Its core lies in exploring how to solve problems such as information processing, data management, and intelligent interaction through the combination of software and hardware. It is not only a fundamental discipline driving the development of the digital age, but also an interdisciplinary field deeply integrated with various industries. Its application scenarios cover a wide range of fields from daily office work to aerospace engineering, from artificial intelligence to the Internet of Things.Computer System Architecture: Studies the collaborative design of computer hardware (such as chips, memory, processors) and software, focusing on system performance optimization, parallel computing, distributed systems, etc.Computer Software and Theory: Covers programming languages, algorithm design and analysis, operating systems, database principles, etc., addressing the issue of "how to efficiently write and run programs".Computer Application Technology: Focuses on the application scenarios of technologies, such as artificial intelligence (machine learning, natural language processing), big data analysis, computer vision, cybersecurity, Internet of Things, etc.Human-Computer Interaction and Multimedia Technology: Studies the interaction methods between humans and computers (such as gesture recognition, virtual reality) and the processing technologies of multimedia information like audio and video.
